evidence.observation: §2 says `api.judgments` "loads the model with `load_model_bytes_composed(mr, source=model_path, root=model_path.parent)`, the composition `gnd check` uses", while R0.6 demands "Every changed route gives byte-identical output for a model that declares no includes". In the checkout, `load_model_bytes_composed` reaches `_composed_view`, which binds any declared reference populations at that `root` and wraps failure as `ReferenceInputError` (src/gnd/model/__init__.py:371-377) before api.py's `bind_declared_references(model, root=reference_root or Path(model_path).parent)` (src/gnd/api.py:1165) can honour `--reference-root` (src/gnd/commands/judgments.py:14, passed at :43). For an include-free model whose reference files resolve only under `--reference-root`, a literal implementation of this bullet refuses with `binding` where today's route judges, so R0.6 does not follow from §2 as written; the IR1 draft spec already branches (compose only when `declares_includes`), which preserves it.

concerns.recommendation: State the branch in §2 IR1: use the composed loader only when the root declares includes (spec decision IR1-D4); an include-free model keeps `load_model_bytes` plus `bind_declared_references(root=reference_root or model_path.parent)`, so reference binding and R0.6 are unchanged for that class.
concerns.title: IR1's unconditional composed load can change output for include-free models judged with --reference-root

evidence.observation: §2: "`gnd extract` on a temporal model keeps refusing, and its message names `gnd flatten` as the route for a temporal include root." IR2-C5: "`gnd extract` on a temporal model, exit 3, message names `gnd flatten`" -- with no qualifier that the model declares includes. Today's message is `f"{consumer} does not support temporal models in Phase 1"` from `require_non_temporal` (src/gnd/terms.py:122, called at src/gnd/extract/service.py:191), and a temporal model without includes is unchanged input under R0.6's byte-identical rule, so the two sentences license different observable refusal messages for the same input.

concerns.recommendation: Make IR2-C5 name a temporal include root as its input (matching §2), or state explicitly in §0/R0.6 that this one refusal message changes for all temporal models and is exempt from the byte-identical control, so the IR2 spec does not have to guess.
concerns.title: IR2-C5 says every temporal `gnd extract` refusal names `gnd flatten`, but §2 scopes the new message to include roots
